items.text:
*UPDATED* I've flipped to Not Recommended: 1.0 was rushed to release and if you've been playing Ostranauts since 0.15-0.13 you know it wasn't ready. Bugs galore. Performance issues. Unfinished shallow systems. The developers have committed to 1 year of continued development, so we'll see if Actual 1.0 improves things in 2027.  

I adore the world Blue Bottle Games has built here, but it seems like ambition exceeding competency (like basic software engineering competency). 
/end update

Very compelling game loop. Brings to mind Stationers, but with much more emphasis on economics and much less on chemistry. You build you own salvage ship from the ships you salvage. Achieving inter-planetary travel is gratifying challenge. Your character's gradual skill improvements are tangible. There is a Dwarf Fortress-like world simulation happening under the hood that motivates the activities of other characters in the solar system, who may try to board you, mug you, beg you for money, or beat you senseless. Otherwise, the vacuum will suck the life out of you if you're careless.

Downsides: performance issues in the form of periodic freezes as your game advances. Side quests are buggy and not particularly motivating when they can be completed. The orbital mechanics simulation is convincing at first, but becomes frustrating and obviously wrong when you later try to dock with an orbital station of an actual planetary body -- and I'll go into detail on this because it's so annoying: some objects like planets and asteroids orbit the sun, but so does everything else, including objects like space stations that should instead be orbiting a planet. The simulation cheats the appearance of N-body orbits by making planetary stations ACCELERATE around their planets. This makes docking with them extremely frustrating because your ship is not in the same inertial frame of reference. I hope this is an Early Access hack, and the full release has proper orbit simulations.
items.text_zh:
*已更新* 我已转为不推荐：1.0 是仓促发布的，如果你从 0.15-0.13 就开始玩 Ostranauts，你就知道它还没准备好。bug 满天飞。性能问题。未完成的浅层系统。开发者承诺继续开发 1 年，所以我们看看 2027 年真正的 1.0 会不会改善情况。

我很喜欢 Blue Bottle Games 在这里构建的世界，但似乎野心超过了能力（比如基本的软件工程能力）。
/更新结束

非常引人入胜的游戏循环。让人想起 Stationers，但更强调经济，化学方面少得多。你用打捞来的飞船建造自己的打捞船。实现行星际旅行是令人满足的挑战。你角色的技能逐步提升是实实在在的。引擎盖下有一个类似《矮人要塞》的世界模拟，驱动着太阳系中其他角色的活动，他们可能会试图登上你的船、抢劫你、向你讨钱，或者把你打得失去知觉。否则，如果你不小心，真空会抽走你的生命。

缺点：随着游戏推进，会出现周期性卡顿形式的性能问题。支线任务有 bug，而且当它们能完成时也并不特别有动力。轨道力学模拟起初令人信服，但当你后来尝试与一个实际行星体上的轨道空间站对接时，就会变得令人沮丧且明显错误——我会详细说明这一点，因为它太烦人了：行星和小行星等一些物体绕太阳运行，但其他一切也都如此，包括本应绕行星运行的空间站等物体。模拟通过让行星空间站绕其行星加速来作弊，以呈现 N 体轨道的表象。这使得与它们对接极其令人沮丧，因为你的飞船不在同一个惯性参考系中。我希望这是抢先体验阶段的权宜之计，而正式发布会有正确的轨道模拟。
